content: ABBA (BIOP): fully automated affine+spline registration of ~50-80 coronal sections completes in under 1 minute on an 8-core CPU (no manual effort). BigWarp manual landmark refinement is the actual time cost: recommended landmark density is a grid parameter of 5-20 (25-400 landmarks per section), placed on white-matter landmarks and DAPI density boundaries; time scales with landmark count and reviewer experience. ABBA is explicitly designed as an accuracy/speed dial: rough registration achievable in a few minutes per animal (all sections), with additional BigWarp refinement time traded for higher precision as needed.
